title: Answers contradict new retrieval settings
description: Pied Piper (v3): after we raised their retrieval depth, some answers still behave like the old setting while others are right. It looks like the model is hallucinating sometimes. Another engineer suspects the Tune team.
provided_evidence: 2025-03-12T10:00:00.020Z INFO ui-r req=req-3a91 tenant=t-piedpiper latency_ms=20 status=ok

ground_truth.root_cause: v3 response cache is not invalidated after the Tune change (rag.cache.invalidate_on_tune_change=false), serving stale answers.

key_questions_needed.topic: time of settings change vs bad answers
trace id of a stale answer

ground_truth.version_caveat: The cache and its invalidation flag exist only in v3; on v1/v2 this symptom has another cause.

scenario.query: How do I reset the device?
